printed_to_pdf_page_rule: PDF page floor((printed page + 6) / 2); even printed page left, odd right. Scan widths vary; use the actual PDF page bounds.
row_scope: 94 explicit Delta nonstop rows in selected northeast/Florida/Canada tables. Connecting/through rows excluded; each independently timed segment retains its own weekdays.
operator_identification: All accepted rows use Delta mainline flight numbers below the Delta Connection ranges.
frequency_legend: D encodes blank/daily; X excludes weekdays, 1 Monday through 7 Sunday. Star denotes off-peak fare, not day rollover.

special_cases.Airport suffixes: J=JFK, L=LGA, E=EWR. Washington N=National/DCA, Miami M=MIA/F=FLL. Repeated Miami/Fort Lauderdale aggregate tables are not separate flights.
special_cases.Canada: Montreal is Dorval/YUL, not Mirabel/YMX. YUL–MIA 215 uses 08:00–11:15 except Saturday and 08:30–11:45 Saturday. MIA–YUL 214 excludes Saturday; 468 operates Saturday.
special_cases.Through rows: YUL–FLL 215 and FLL–YUL 468 have a stop in Miami. Only separate YUL–MIA, MIA–FLL, FLL–MIA and MIA–YUL rows are imported. Other through itineraries excluded.
special_cases.Footnotes: Six accepted rows with footnote 4 start 12 February 1986: JFK–FLL 721, FLL–JFK 720, BOS–FLL 189, FLL–BOS 594, BOS–PBI 891 and PBI–BOS 818. All are effective before the import window.
special_cases.Exact minutes: BOS–FLL 189 arrives 22:56 (also repeated in YUL–FLL via BOS); FLL–BOS is 136, not 138. BOS–PBI is 891 (also in connecting itineraries). Exact minutes and printed footnotes retained.
special_cases.Opposite directions: Delta 494 has separately printed LGA–PBI and PBI–LGA services, with non-overlapping times. The shared number is not treated as a duplicate.
special_cases.Aircraft: No individual aircraft type or registration inferred from generic equipment symbols.
special_cases.Airport locations: Historical airport names/codes follow pp.260–261. Modern reference coordinates serve only as approximate same-airfield markers.
